name: Black bag limit exemption
description: Application to Swansea Council for permission to place out additional black bags of non-recyclable household waste where all accepted kerbside materials are recycled and excess waste arises from nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding.

decision_gates.title: Application completeness
decision_gates.check: Application includes mandatory applicant identity, address, postcode, phone number, email address, exemption item selection, and successful online submission validation.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Application is incomplete because mandatory form fields or submission validation are missing.

decision_gates.title: Swansea household address
decision_gates.check: Application relates to a household address within the Swansea Council area, confirmed from submitted address and postcode details.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Application does not relate to a Swansea household address.

decision_gates.title: Eligible waste category
decision_gates.check: Selected exemption item is one of the stated categories: Nappies, Pet litter, or Pet bedding.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Waste type does not fall within the stated exemption categories.

decision_gates.title: Excess residual waste threshold
decision_gates.check: Household produces more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Household does not produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste.

decision_gates.title: Recycling behaviour
decision_gates.check: Applicant recycles all accepted kerbside materials and the application does not indicate avoidable recyclable waste is being placed in residual waste.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Applicant does not recycle all accepted kerbside materials.

decision_gates.title: No recyclable material in bags
decision_gates.check: There is no recyclable material present in any black bags or exemption bags, based on application information and any monitoring or compliance information available to the council.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Recyclable material is present in black bags or exemption bags.

decision_gates.title: Terms and conditions compliance
decision_gates.check: Application can be granted consistently with the council's stated terms and conditions and monitoring approach for black bag limit exemptions.
decision_gates.fail_reason: Application does not meet the council's terms and conditions for exemption.

evidence_checklist.name: Applicant full name
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check that the applicant's full name is present on the submitted form.

evidence_checklist.name: Household address
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check address selected through postcode lookup or entered manually and confirm it is a household address in Swansea Council area.

evidence_checklist.name: Postcode lookup result
evidence_checklist.conditional_on: Where address is selected from postcode lookup results
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Validate that the selected address matches the submitted postcode and populated address fields.

evidence_checklist.name: Manual address lines
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check Address line 1, Address line 2, Town, and Postcode are completed where manual entry is used.

evidence_checklist.name: Phone number
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check that a contact telephone number is present on the application.

evidence_checklist.name: Mobile number
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Record optional mobile number for contact purposes.

evidence_checklist.name: Email address
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Check that a valid email field is present for correspondence.

evidence_checklist.name: Exemption item selection
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Confirm selected item is exactly one of: Nappies, Pet litter, Pet bedding.

evidence_checklist.name: Additional information text
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Caseworker reviews free-text explanation for consistency with the threshold of more than 3 black bags and the selected exemption category.

evidence_checklist.name: Declaration of recycling all accepted kerbside materials
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Caseworker assesses application content and any available service history to determine whether the household appears to recycle all accepted kerbside materials.

evidence_checklist.name: Declaration that no recyclable material is present in black or exemption bags
evidence_checklist.verification_method: Caseworker assesses application content and any available monitoring or compliance information to confirm no recyclable material is present in black or exemption bags.

evidence_checklist.name: reCAPTCHA completion
evidence_checklist.verification_method: System validates successful reCAPTCHA completion before submission is accepted.

correspondence_templates.name: Acknowledgement of Application
correspondence_templates.subject: Black bag limit exemption application received – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

Thank you for your application for a Black bag limit exemption for {{ address_line_1 }}, {{ postcode }}.

We have received your application on {{ submission_date }}.

Your reference number is {{ case_reference }}. Please keep this for your records.

We will assess your application against the council's published eligibility criteria, including:
1. whether your household is in the Swansea Council area
2. whether you produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste
3. whether you recycle all accepted kerbside materials
4. whether the exemption relates to an eligible waste type: nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding
5. whether there is any recyclable material in black bags or exemption bags

If we need more information, we will contact you using the details you provided.

The scraped service information does not publish a decision timescale, so we cannot confirm a statutory or published deadline for a decision. If your application is granted, the exemption is issued for an initial period of 1 year and may be subject to monitoring.

Relevant policy references: BBE-ELIG-01, BBE-ELIG-02, BBE-ELIG-03, BBE-ELIG-04, BBE-ELIG-05, BBE-ELIG-06.

If you need to contact us, please reply to this email and quote your reference number.

Yours sincerely,
Waste Services
Swansea Council

This is an automated message. Please do not send recyclable materials in black bags or exemption bags. Standard council privacy and records handling terms apply.

correspondence_templates.name: Evidence Request
correspondence_templates.subject: Further information required – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We need further information before we can continue assessing your Black bag limit exemption application for {{ address_line_1 }}, {{ postcode }}.

Please provide the following by {{ evidence_due_date }}:
{{ numbered_evidence_list }}

This request has been made so we can complete checks under policy references BBE-ELIG-01, BBE-ELIG-02, BBE-ELIG-03, BBE-ELIG-04, BBE-ELIG-05 and BBE-ELIG-06.

You should reply using the same contact route or follow the submission instructions provided by the council.

If we do not receive the requested information within 28 days of this request, we may decide your application based on the information already available. This may result in refusal where mandatory information is missing or eligibility cannot be established.

The information we request may include clarification of your address, contact details, selected exemption category, or further explanation of why your household produces more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste while recycling all accepted kerbside materials.

If you no longer wish to continue with your application, please tell us as soon as possible.

Yours sincerely,
Waste Services
Swansea Council

There is no published appeal or review deadline in the source material. If a refusal is later issued, any available complaint or review route will be explained in that decision letter if applicable.

correspondence_templates.name: Decision: Approved
correspondence_templates.subject: Decision on your Black bag limit exemption application – {{ case_reference }}
correspondence_templates.body:
Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have approved your application for a Black bag limit exemption for:
{{ full_address }}

Reference: {{ case_reference }}
Decision date: {{ decision_date }}
Exemption category: {{ exemption_item }}

Decision
Your application has been approved because, on the information available, your household meets the council's eligibility criteria.

This decision has been made with reference to:
- BBE-ELIG-02: Swansea household address
- BBE-ELIG-03: Eligible waste category
- BBE-ELIG-04: More than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste
- BBE-ELIG-05: Recycling all accepted kerbside materials
- BBE-ELIG-06: No recyclable material in black bags or exemption bags
- BBE-OPS-01: Terms and conditions and monitoring

What this means
Your exemption is granted for an initial period of 1 year from {{ valid_from_date }} to {{ valid_to_date }}.

Important conditions
- You must continue to recycle all accepted kerbside materials.
- There must be no recyclable material in any black bags or exemption bags.
- The exemption applies only to the eligible waste category recorded above.
- Your waste may be monitored by the council during the validity period.
- If the exemption is no longer appropriate, the council may review the case.

The source material does not describe a renewal process, so you should follow any future instructions issued by the council before the end of the initial 1 year period.

If you have questions about this decision, please contact Waste Services and quote your reference number.

Yours sincerely,
Waste Services
Swansea Council

Decision date: {{ decision_date }}

Decision
After considering the information available, we are not satisfied that your application meets the council's eligibility criteria.

Reason for refusal
{{ refusal_reason }}

Relevant policy references
{{ refusal_policy_refs }}

Examples of refusal grounds under the council's criteria include:
- the address is not a Swansea household address
- the selected waste type is not one of the eligible categories of nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding
- the household does not produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste
- the household does not recycle all accepted kerbside materials
- recyclable material is present in black bags or exemption bags
- mandatory information needed to determine eligibility has not been provided

The source material reviewed for this case does not publish a statutory appeal right, administrative review route, or refusal deadline. For that reason, there is no stated appeal deadline of 28 days outside the UK or 14 days inside the UK for this case type, and no published administrative review timescale has been identified.

If you believe we have misunderstood the information in your application, you may contact Swansea Council Waste Services to provide clarification or to ask about any available complaints process.

Yours sincerely,
Waste Services
Swansea Council

risk_factors.name: Recyclable material found in black or exemption bags
risk_factors.trigger: Application information, monitoring records, or compliance history indicates recyclable material is being placed in black bags or exemption bags.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Refuse the application or escalate for compliance review because the exemption requires no recyclable material in black or exemption bags.

risk_factors.name: Household does not appear to recycle all accepted kerbside materials
risk_factors.trigger: Application content or service history suggests the household is not recycling all accepted kerbside materials.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Refuse the application and record the evidence relied on.

risk_factors.name: Selected waste type outside permitted categories
risk_factors.trigger: Selected exemption item is not Nappies, Pet litter, or Pet bedding, or free text contradicts the selected category.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Request clarification if likely input error; otherwise refuse under eligible waste category rules.

risk_factors.name: Threshold of more than 3 black bags not evidenced
risk_factors.trigger: Application information suggests the household does not exceed more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Refuse the application unless clarification resolves the discrepancy.

risk_factors.name: Mandatory address or contact details missing
risk_factors.trigger: Required fields such as address, postcode, phone number, or email are incomplete or inconsistent.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Issue an evidence request and place the case in awaiting_evidence.

risk_factors.name: Address appears outside Swansea Council area
risk_factors.trigger: Submitted postcode or address does not appear to fall within Swansea Council area.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Verify area eligibility and refuse if the address is not a Swansea household address.

risk_factors.name: Additional information conflicts with selected exemption reason
risk_factors.trigger: Free-text explanation suggests a different waste type or indicates general excess waste rather than nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding.

risk_factors.name: Prior monitoring or compliance concerns recorded
risk_factors.trigger: Council monitoring history indicates previous non-compliance with waste presentation conditions.
risk_factors.caseworker_action: Route for senior review and consider refusal or enhanced monitoring if approved.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Application is complete, address is in Swansea, and no risk factor above medium is triggered
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Most straightforward household exemption applications can be handled by the standard waste services processing queue.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Application has missing mandatory information or conflicting address/contact details
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Specialist review is needed to resolve completeness and address validation issues before eligibility can be determined.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Monitoring history, compliance concerns, or evidence of recyclable material in black or exemption bags is present
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Potential non-compliance cases require senior oversight because they may lead to refusal and future monitoring action.

auto_assignment_rules.condition: Selected exemption category is unclear or free text suggests an ineligible waste type
auto_assignment_rules.reason: Specialist assessment is needed to determine whether the application falls within the limited eligible categories.

policy_references.title: Application completeness and mandatory submission fields
policy_references.criteria: Application must include mandatory applicant details, address details, contact details, exemption item selection, and successful online submission validation.

policy_references.title: Swansea household address requirement
policy_references.criteria: Application must relate to a household address within the Swansea Council area.

policy_references.title: Eligible waste category requirement
policy_references.criteria: Exemption is available only for stated categories such as disposable nappies, pet litter, or pet bedding.

policy_references.title: Residual waste threshold
policy_references.criteria: Household must produce more than 3 black bags of non-recyclable waste.

policy_references.title: Kerbside recycling requirement
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must recycle all accepted kerbside materials and still produce excess non-recyclable waste.

policy_references.title: No recyclable material in black or exemption bags
policy_references.criteria: No recyclable material may be present in any black bags or exemption bags for an exemption to be granted.

policy_references.title: Grant conditions, initial validity and monitoring
policy_references.criteria: If granted, the exemption is issued for an initial period of 1 year and may be subject to monitoring and terms and conditions.

policy_references.title: Online submission validation
policy_references.criteria: Applicant must complete reCAPTCHA and submit the online form successfully for the application to be received.
